audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Yone level 1 and Mordekaiser every stage from 3 onward including 2+ items, and the packet flags it: Yone wins 56.14% over 3297 games but the chart hands Mordekaiser 5/7 stages with no Yone row at all after level 1.
audit.why: The mirror (mordekaiser__yone) has already been audited to Skill / Mordekaiser / Mordekaiser / Skill / Mordekaiser / Mordekaiser / Yone. Level 1 Morde has Obliterate only and no shield yet, so it is a coin flip; level 2 Indestructible turns it his way; 4-5 is even because Obliterate is down to 5s while your Q3 dash trades back; and a farmed Yone flips the realm at two items, which whys[6] already said.
audit.corrected: Both layers set to Skill / Mordekaiser / Mordekaiser / Skill / Mordekaiser / Mordekaiser / Yone as one atomic paired group, matching the mirror exactly, with ratings and the contradicting why lines rewritten.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text named Realm of Death but gave no cooldown, so 'save E and R for it' had no timing attached, and the level-6 phase claimed Fate Sealed 'sets up team knockups'.
audit.why: Realm of Death is 140/120/100s — the longest cooldown in the lane and the single thing worth tracking. Indestructible is 12/11/10/9/8s, which is the real trade-window clock at levels 2-5.
audit.corrected: Put the 140/120/100s realm cooldown into spikes[1].text and the 8-12s Indestructible clock into phases[1].why.

audit.whatIsWrong: Fate Sealed was described as a knockup setter in phases[4].why and breakdown.late. It is a blink behind the last champion in a line plus a pull toward Yone; the knockup belongs to the third Mortal Steel cast. Death's Grasp was referenced only as 'his E pull' with no range or cooldown, and dosFull[2].d and dontsFull[1].d carried text about Realm of Death and about wasting cooldowns that had nothing to do with the E they were titled for. Soul Unbound's damage repeat on snap-back was never stated.
audit.why: Riot ability text in the brief; the mirror recorded the same Fate Sealed correction, so both sides now read identically.
audit.corrected: Fate Sealed restated as blink-behind-and-pull, Death's Grasp given its 700 range and 16/14/12/10/8 cooldown and tied to why Obliterate lands, and Soul Unbound's damage repeat stated as the reason to hold it for the realm.

audit.why: Indestructible converts stored damage into a heal, so Grievous Wounds decides extended trades — the missingInteractions entry asked for anti-heal.
audit.corrected: Already covered: report[8].t calls for early Executioner's Calling and breakdown.late keeps anti-heal core. No edit needed.

audit.whatIsWrong: The kit file tags Obliterate with a grounding flag ('shuts off enemy dashes'), which Riot's own description of the ability does not support — the text is only a ground smash with bonus damage on a single target.
audit.why: Per the calibration rule, where a derived flag contradicts Riot's description the description wins.
audit.corrected: No grounding claim written anywhere. Flagged here so the flag can be fixed at source rather than shipped as advice.
